question: Does the AB06/AB07 difference arise from intrinsic anatomy or preparation?
answer: The pair changes anatomy, preparation-derived reference kinematics and contact interaction together. No unique anatomical/preparation share is identified. No accidental retained-biological or dynamic conversion mutation was found; explicit preparation conventions and an AB06-calibrated contact law remain mechanisms to isolate.

interpretation: This quantifies the direct response of the frozen force law to the preparation-associated ankle trajectory at fixed current geometry and all other coordinates.
It does not identify total preparation effect: registered distal mounting, other marker-induced IK changes and muscle mechanics remain fixed, and no hybrid dynamics is simulated.
The sparse force basis is disjoint from the display STL and AB06-derived; static ground matching alone does not validate its force generalization.
Original actual paired metrics remain authoritative for observed rollout comparison; this supplemental grid includes exact TO points.
preparation_associated_ankle_probe.finding: At fixed registered AB07 geometry and all other current filtered coordinates, the pre-ground ankle reference raises impulse. The current preparation-associated ankle change reduces it by about20.46% relative to that probe. This excludes that isolated change as the origin of the present direct excess, but does not quantify total preparation effect.

methodology.scope: Saved-data FK and direct contact-law arithmetic only; no assembly, dynamics, integration, policy, IK optimization or input edits.
methodology.grid: Each frozen primary HS/TO/next-HS at full precision plus every native1ms timestamp strictly inside the common primary window.
methodology.q_qdot: actual/served use independent saved q/qdot columns in radians/metres; interpolated only at inserted exact boundaries. Raw IK rotations degree→rad then full-trial CubicSpline derivatives. Filtered IK uses the recorded production KinematicsInterpolator settings over the full source trial.
methodology.hybrids: Replace both q and qdot by coordinate name; retain each subject own model. Diagnostic poses, not feasible dynamic counterfactuals.
methodology.force: Exact C++ smooth-positive spring/dissipation/friction/residual law; native plugin parity at11 probes per case and side, all spheres.
methodology.BW: Fixed runtime mass*9.80665 for reporting; never enters the contact law.
methodology.sensitivity: Fixed ±1/5/10mm arithmetic primary-plane shifts; not tuned, not applied to runtime inputs.
methodology.mesh: Minimum plane clearance over exact convex-hull vertices of the shared hardware STL; display mesh has no contact force.
methodology.boundary_effect: Nonlinear contact law of linearly interpolated q/qdot at inserted boundaries need not equal linearly interpolated native force; native parity compares original saved timestamps only.

shared_contact_profile.sensitivity_conditions: All eight left basis spheres active, zero normal velocity, and negligible smoothing. This is an analytic local sensitivity, not the integrated result or a new calibrated profile.

causal_distinctions: Healthy body mass and retained biological geometry are intrinsic inputs; total mass is preserved by the graft.
Donor mass redistribution, donor COM and mass-scaled donor inertias, donor proximal-left muscles and mounting/marker calibration are preparation choices common to or derived for subjects.
A preparation step can comply with its source contract and still require independent physical qualification.
The identical contact profile is calibrated on AB06 states and is not an independently identified subject-independent material/sole law.
Pose-only contact forces do not depend on muscle recruitment or mass; those can change dynamically attained poses indirectly.
Healthy experimental left GRF is a reference for the virtual prosthesis benchmark, not an experimental recording from this virtual hardware.
AB06 original receipt remains failed at its final adapter boundary; the primary physical cycles and native outputs remain intact.

next_discriminating_experiments_not_exec.question: Does the new preparation pipeline preserve the AB06 benchmark?
next_discriminating_experiments_not_exec.design: Build AB06 in an isolated directory from the same frozen healthy/donor/static sources, verify expected geometry/marker/IK differences, then compare to current AB06 with the same fixed controller and three preselected nominal cycles.
next_discriminating_experiments_not_exec.limit: A successful AB06 round trip excludes a broad pipeline regression but does not prove subject-specific AB07 fitting correct.

next_discriminating_experiments_not_exec.question: How much comes from preparation on the same anatomy?
next_discriminating_experiments_not_exec.design: Keep healthy AB07, measured loading, profiles and controllers fixed; compare isolated, explicitly justified preparation variants one at a time. Preserve subject-scaled proximal muscle paths/lengths in one branch; test mounting/marker calibration separately with new IK from the same markers and independent static constraints.
next_discriminating_experiments_not_exec.limit: Changing mount geometry with frozen incompatible IK is only a pose sensitivity experiment. A dynamic preparation comparison must document IK/marker consistency for each branch.

next_discriminating_experiments_not_exec.question: Is the common AB06 contact law transferable?
next_discriminating_experiments_not_exec.design: Evaluate a common independently justified hardware/contact model or fit any candidate on separate calibration data, then compare both subjects on frozen holdout cycles. Preserve left online/right measured application and SEA semantics.
next_discriminating_experiments_not_exec.limit: Refitting contact to the evaluated AB07 GRF and scoring on those same cycles cannot establish generalization or physical identification.
